questions.q: A customer with a standard sweep booking asks for a $35 discount. Can the assistant grant it without asking anyone?
questions.gold: yes, up to $35 on standard sweeps is allowed

questions.q: A customer booking a camera inspection asks for a $20 discount. Can the assistant grant it on its own? If not, who must approve?
questions.gold: no, camera inspection discounts need approval from Nadia Fenwick, the office manager

questions.q: A customer is owed a refund of exactly $120. Does it require Nadia Fenwick's approval?
questions.gold: no, only refunds above $120 need her approval

questions.q: Ist Tobias Grell der Inhaber von Kestrel Flue & Chimney? Wer ist es sonst?
questions.gold: no, Tobias Grell is the lead technician; the owner is Ruth Calloway

questions.q: While answering a customer complaint, may the assistant copy Emil Calloway on the reply?
questions.gold: no, Emil Calloway must never be copied on a customer complaint

questions.q: Two customers each ask to move their booking 30 hours before the appointment. Ms. Avery has an active annual service plan; Mr. Bose does not. Whose move is free of charge?
questions.gold: only Ms. Avery's (service-plan customers can move free up to 12 hours before); Mr. Bose would need 48 hours

questions.q: A quote request arrives by email on Thursday morning. By when must it be answered?
questions.gold: by Friday 17:00 (next business day)

questions.q: 客户来信说烟雾正在进入房屋。助手必须做什么？要告诉客户哪两件事？
questions.gold: call the on-call technician line 555-0148 yourself; tell the customer a technician has been alerted, and that they must close the stove's air damper and leave the house

questions.q: In the smoke emergency, who is supposed to close the stove's air damper: the assistant, the technician, or the customer?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: With which sentence must every reply to a complaint end, and when is the open-quotes summary sent?
questions.gold: "Thank you for helping us keep your hearth safe."; every Friday at 16:00 to Nadia Fenwick

questions.q: From what date do the new parcel-locker rules apply?
questions.gold: 8 March 2027 (Monday)

questions.q: How long is free storage for an ordinary parcel, and how long for a cold-chain fresh parcel?
questions.gold: 24 hours for ordinary parcels, 12 hours for cold-chain parcels

questions.q: An ordinary parcel is collected exactly 60 hours after it was put into the locker. How much is the overtime fee?
questions.gold: 1.5 yuan (36 hours over = 3 × 0.5 yuan)

questions.q: 一个大件包裹于3月10日入柜，行动不便的业主能否使用免费代取服务？
questions.gold: yes, the March 15 date limit applies only to cold-chain parcels, not large parcels

questions.q: 一个冷链包裹于3月12日入柜，行动不便的业主能否使用免费代取服务？
questions.gold: no, only cold-chain parcels deposited after March 15 qualify

questions.q: The first Wednesday of a month is a public holiday. When does the locker maintenance take place that month?
questions.gold: on the next day (Thursday), 9:00 to 11:00

questions.q: 快递柜管理员是谁？电话是多少？
questions.gold: Zheng Xiaolan, 138 0571 2269

questions.q: A parcel has not been collected for more than 7 days. Where does it go, what must the resident bring, and what is the fee?
questions.gold: it is moved to the property service center; bring an ID card; 5 yuan storage fee

questions.q: Can a resident open the locker to collect a parcel at 23:30?
questions.gold: no, the lockers are open only 6:00–23:00

questions.q: Ein Kunde bestellt Chlortabletten (Pflegechemikalien) für genau 250 Euro nach. Darf der Assistent die Bestellung selbst bestätigen?

questions.gold: no, spare parts always need approval from Lukas Brandauer, the workshop manager, regardless of amount

questions.q: May the tax adviser Herr Kessel be copied on an email about a customer complaint?
questions.gold: no, never

questions.gold: only Frau Maier (contract customers can book until 30 April; others only until 15 April)

questions.q: A customer asks by email how much chlorine to add to their pool. May the assistant give a dosage recommendation?

questions.q: In the chlorine-smell emergency, who switches off the pool pump at the main switch?

questions.gold: "Vielen Dank, dass Sie uns darauf hinweisen."; every Monday at 9:00

questions.q: Klient zamawia rośliny i nawozy za dokładnie 180 zł. Czy asystent może samodzielnie potwierdzić zamówienie?
questions.gold: yes, up to 180 zł is allowed
